name: Mat ong U Minh
summary: Mật ong U Minh is honey from the melaleuca flowers, taken by gác kèo ong, the rafter set to draw the bees. Eat it by the spoon, or carry a jar home.
origin: U Minh Hạ. The national tourism page calls it the largest tram forest in the country and says the provincial science office registered a shared brand. A Vietnam record for a bee colony was set at the 2022 Hương rừng U Minh festival.
culture: The 2019 Người Lao Động piece is the heritage note for gác kèo ong, named with muối ba khía as national intangible heritage.
howToEat: By the spoon, or carried home. The pages do not print a café ritual.
A harvest month was not printed on the official pages. Check on arrival.
where: U Minh Hạ. A jar in the city market is the souvenir, not a picked stall. Check on arrival for a price.
